Hello there! My name is Nivedita Bhaskhar and I am a Machine Learning Engineer. In my past avatar as a pure mathematician, I worked with mathematical structures called *algebraic groups*. To know more, visit my main [website](https://nivbhaskhar.github.io).

I like to write about mathematics, machine learning and quantum computing. I hope these pieces provide some appetizing food for thought! 

Please do include a backlink and cite these articles if you use them in any form. Each post features a copyable BibTeX entry and standard format attribution at the end.
